leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: One league per line. Common names work: epl, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl, mls, nba, wnba, nfl, mlb, nhl. Any other ESPN league works as sport/league, e.g. soccer/ken.1 (Kenyan Premier League), soccer/bra.1, cricket/8048 (IPL), basketball/mens-college-basketball.

dataType.title: What to fetch
dataType.description: Scores and fixtures gives one row per game. Standings gives one row per team in the league table.
enumTitles: Scores and fixtures (1 row per game)

startDate.title: From date
startDate.description: First day to fetch games for, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for the current slate (recent and upcoming games). Ignored for standings.

endDate.title: To date
endDate.description: Last day to fetch games for, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to fetch a single day. Ranges are capped at 31 days per run. Ignored for standings.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total (protects your budget on long date ranges).
